evals.prompt: Analyze this 500MB Telegram Desktop export containing 12 chats for tool requests and unmet needs. I want to know what people are looking for.
evals.expected_output: Agent streams file in 4MB chunks with overlap tails, never loads entire file into memory, applies the need lexicon (Russian + English), captures up to 6 evidence examples per keyword, clusters hits into need themes ranked by cross-chat frequency, and grounds every theme with 2-5 verbatim quotes with dates.
evals.name: large_multichat_export

evals.prompt: Here is a 200MB Telegram export from a Russian tech community. Find repeated complaints and tool requests.
evals.expected_output: Agent applies Russian need lexicon (вот бы, не хватает, бесит, надоело, задолбал, ищу инструмент, etc.), streams in chunks, clusters findings into need themes, ranks by cross-chat frequency, provides verbatim Russian quotes with dates, and ends with a Coverage check section stating which existing tools address each theme.
evals.name: russian_chat_need_mining

evals.prompt: Load this 1.2GB result.json file and analyze all messages for product opportunities.
evals.expected_output: Agent REFUSES to load the entire file. Instead, reads only the first 4KB to fingerprint the chat, then streams in fixed-size chunks (e.g. 4MB). Never uses cat on the file. States the chunk-based methodology and sample coverage in the output.
evals.name: memory_safety_validation
